summary: Built the code generation system that converts visual workflows into executable LangChain TypeScript code. Implemented: codeFormatting.ts (import deduplication/sorting, camelCase variable naming, JSDoc generation, file headers), nodeTemplates.ts (template functions for upload/extract/transform/output nodes with LangChain integrations and error handling), chainTemplates.ts (assembles nodes into chains using connection topology with multi-input support), codeGenerator.ts (main service with Kahn's algorithm topological sort, cycle detection, workflow validation, and complete code assembly). All 49 tests pass, TypeScript compiles cleanly, and 50+ node workflows generate in under 500ms.
